message.njw_just_end_portal.portal_limit: You can install one outgoing End portal in the Overworld and one in the End.
message.njw_just_end_portal.awaiting_lin: An End Portal Generator awaiting a link can only be placed in the dimension opposite its source portal.
message.njw_just_end_portal.expansion_no: You can only expand an End portal that you created.
message.njw_just_end_portal.expansion_to: An End portal cannot exceed 3 × 3 blocks.
message.njw_just_end_portal.expansion_op: The corresponding arrival-platform position in the other dimension must be empty.
